decisions.reason: Allowing selection between ETH and USDC does not change the existing crypto-only launch mode or the deferred availability of fiat payment.
The same-message INTRODUCE already captures that ETH wallet payment is enabled; no additional state change or omitted attribute is necessary.
USDC wallet minting was already required; making USDC selectable alongside ETH changes payment-method selection, not the USDC mint flow itself.
Wallet currency selection for ETH and USDC does not alter how fiat buyers access commissions, tickets, prizes, or their dashboard.
The accepted ETH/USDC wallet selector does not change the provider, conversion asset, supported methods, lifecycle, or behavior of the separate Transak fiat flow.
Selecting between wallet-held ETH and USDC does not change background wallet provisioning for fiat buyers.
The source changes selectable wallet currencies but does not change any primary-sale allocation or fee treatment.
Supporting ETH and USDC as selectable payment currencies does not alter the $15 mint price or its advertised price commitment.
The currency-selection decision does not change whether tipping is offered, its placement, or its preset and custom amounts.
The NFT ebook and unlimited-supply mint semantics remain unchanged; the source only changes which wallet payment currencies can be selected.
The accepted payment selector does not necessarily require any change to the current About page copy or resolve its reward-delivery ambiguity.
Both ETH and USDC wallet payments remain crypto flows governed by the existing SIWE requirement; currency selection does not change authentication behavior.
